Meanwhile, key technologies involved such as: middleware, mathematical modeling, frequent pattern mining are highlighted. The system has been successfully implemented in an aerospace laboratory and intelligent equipment information management has been realized.

articleTitle: Factors affecting O2O e-commerce take-away online review
abstract: The paper analyzed what affecting O2O e-commerce take-away industry online review in China in recent years, and how these factors work. Also, it obtained the ranking of these factors' influence. The study used Rost CM6.0 to draw some information from a third-party take-away platform, and established a model by using binary logistic regression. Lastly, SPSS was used to analyze data. The results are:1) affecting factors contain time, price, convenience, service and advertisement;2) time and price have negative effect on online review, while convenience, service and advertisement have positive effect on online review;3) the impact extent of convenience is high than that of other factors.

articleTitle: Research on public transport fuel subsidy allocation model
abstract: This study highlights the importance to develop a scientific mathematical allocation model that is operable and practicable, explores the relationship between vehicle fuel consumption and the various influencing factors. Apart from the factors recognized in the previous studies, such as cylinder, displacement and weight, this study addresses the significance of the involvement of road and environmental factors in vehicle fuel consumption. By analyzing the data obtained from Management System, the impacts of various factor coefficients are determined. An evaluation index system for bus fuel consumption is designed, and a model of allocating the subsidy is constructed. Besides, managerial implications are also discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Analysis of affecting factors on power sustainable development based on ISM model
abstract: In this paper, a simple model for sustainable architecture ISM factors affecting power to analyze the relationship between the structure of the main system factors is proposed. Through a lot of literature to read with the status of power development, 14 factors have been selected. The establishment of the adjacency matrix, reachable matrix, and then draw the elements of the system structure. Then directly the relationship located between different levels of the relationship between the factors multi-level hierarchical model, as well as the same level of analysis between the relevant factors is analyzed. The main factors for a sustainable impact electricity, power development and the status of existing electric power structure analysis and take optimization methods to achieve power through sustainable development. Especially in the “11th Five-Year” Electricity enterprise reform and proposed “12th Five-Year” after sustainable development issues, this method for the power Sustainable is practical significance.

articleTitle: Knowledge transfer in homogeneous networks with consideration of self-learning mechanism
abstract: Depending on the fact that knowledge can be learned by oneself, which is different from epidemic spreading, we take into account self-learning mechanism in the knowledge transfer process. In this paper, we propose a knowledge transfer model, and derive the mean-field equations that describe the dynamics of the knowledge transfer in homogeneous networks. Using differential theory, we obtain the knowledge transfer threshold and solution of the mean-field equations. Both the solution and threshold are closely related with self-learning rate. In addition, numerical simulations are performed to verify the reasonability of the theoretical analysis. The results indicate that the self-learning mechanism have obvious promoting effect on the knowledge transfer in homogeneous networks.

articleTitle: Application study on knowledge representation of emergency scenario using hybrid Petri net
abstract: Knowledge representation of emergency scenario is the foundation of the emergency information management. Emergency scenario is a hybrid dynamic system which has both continuous progress of the evolution and discrete events. In order to improve the comprehensiveness and systematization of emergency scenario characterization, the methodology based on hybrid Petri net was brought, in which both the discrete event of scenario and continuous progress of the evolution were characterized clearly. Elements of accident scenario were expressed normatively by knowledge element model and hierarchical theory and the standardized descriptions of different scenario stages were achieved. A case study of oil pipeline leak was applied and the whole application process indicated that both the logic form of hybrid Petri net and feature of attribute expression by knowledge element model were revealed. The application result presents the scenario situation of the emergent events more objectively and it will help to provide a formalized expression of emergency knowledge when establishing the emergency knowledge base.

articleTitle: Single-machine scheduling problems with variable processing times and delivery times involving double position-dependent effects
abstract: A general model on single-machine scheduling problems with past-sequence-dependent delivery times is developed in this paper, where the actual processing time of a job is defined by a function of its position in a schedule. Moreover, position-dependent effects in both processing times and delivery times are considered simultaneously. Problems with completion time related criteria are presented and the following objective functions: the makespan, the flowtime, the total absolute differences in completion times and their linear combinations are studied. It is shown that all the studied problems can be solved by polynomial-time algorithm.

articleTitle: The impact of sina micro-blog social media information strategy on customer perceived support and customer recommendation
abstract: With the rapid development of social media, how to effectively motivate customers to meet and achieve the purpose of publicity has become an urgent problem to be solved at present. This paper aims at exploring the impact of social media information strategy in enterprise micro-blog on customer perceived support and customer recommendation. Through the empirical analysis of 388 valid random samples, the results show some useful conclusions. First, the information entertainment strategy, real-time strategy and interactive strategy in social media strategy have significant positive effects on customer perceived support of micro-blog propaganda. Second, customer perceived support has a positive impact on customer recommendation. Therefore, enterprises should have a correct understanding of customer engagement affecting the micro-blog platform significantly. So, the enterprise should adopt effective social media information strategy, so as to improve the effect of customer recommendation.

articleTitle: Motivations for and barriers to offshoring development projects to China : A case study of the automotive industry
abstract: Motivations for and barriers to offshoring can significantly depend on the destination country and industry. With the growing importance of the Chinese market for the automobile industry, research & development (R&D) activities of foreign automobile manufacturers have increased in China. Hence, in this study, we examine motivations for and barriers to offshoring development projects to China with a focus on the automotive industry. Twenty-one project practitioners were interviewed as part of two case studies of two offshoring automotive projects, and an extended qualitative analysis was conducted. As a main motivation, compliance with regulatory requirements was identified for offshoring projects to China. In contrast, cost savings show no motivational significance. Furthermore, the lack of qualified staff and weak protection of intellectual property (IP) rights are perceived as barriers by the participants of the study. Thus, quality offshoring preparation is one key in dealing with known barriers to offshoring projects to China.

articleTitle: The policy performance evaluation of new energy automobile industry based on DEA method
abstract: In view of the effect of industrial policy implementation, we constructed a policy performance evaluation index system based on “input-output” after deeply study the related research results of the performance evaluation of policy and the status quo of new energy vehicle industry in Sichuan province. This paper use EDA method to evaluate the samples from the aspects of effectiveness, scale benefit and projection analysis. Finally, the paper puts forward the policy optimization measures to provide reference on the development of new energy vehicles for the long-term strategic policy and short-term stage adjustment policy of Sichuan Province.

articleTitle: Study on the combination evaluation of military resources allocation efficiency
abstract: Aiming at the problems of redundant construction, decentralized investment and extravagance in the current military resource allocation, this paper proposes a new combination evaluation model based on Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) and matter-element analysis. The model integrates the merits of AHP and matter-element analysis, and solves the common incompatibility problem of multi-index evaluation on the basis of scientifically designing the evaluation indicator system and the indicator weight of the military resources allocation efficiency. The method is flexible and easy to calculate, with good operability, good adaptability and good expandability.

articleTitle: Container oriented job scheduling using linear programming model
abstract: With Docker gaining widespread popularity in the recent years, the container scheduler becomes a crucial role for the exploding containerized applications and services. In this work, the container host energy conservation, the container image pulling costs from the image registry to the container hosts and the workload network transition costs from the clients to the container hosts are evaluated in combination. By modeling the scheduling problem as an integer linear programming, an effective and adaptive scheduler is proposed. Impressive cost savings were achieved compared to Docker Swarm scheduler. Moreover, it can be easily integrated into the open-source container orchestration frameworks.

articleTitle: Research on the architecture and strategies of yunnan rural human resources smart development in the era of big data
abstract: Yunnan is an agricultural province with largely rural population. The rural human resources' qualities determine the results of new rural construction and agriculture economic development. In the era of big data, the construction of education smart cloud platform is conducive to the development of human resources in rural areas of Yunnan. The article has analyzed the current development situations of E-education in rural areas of Yunnan; built a framework of rural human resources development based on smart education; and put forward the countermeasures about the development of smart educating for peasants, which are strengthening the construction of the basic supporting system; improving the smart environment; increasing resources; strengthen the management and service; moving smart teaching, etc.

articleTitle: Link prediction of datasets sameAS interlinking network on web of data
abstract: In order to be considered as Linked Data, the datasets on the web must be linked to other datasets. Current studies on dataset interlinking prediction researches do not distinguish the type of links, which are of less help for real application scenarios, as dataset publishers still do not know what kinds of RDF links can be established and furthermore how to configure the data linking algorithms. In this paper, we focus on predicting the possible links between datasets with the most important RDF link type, owl:sameAs. Since the goal is to discriminate between linked dataset pairs against not-linked ones, we formulate the link prediction problem as a classification problem. We adopt Random Forest as the basic classifier to incorporate features of the scores output by unsupervised predictors, and apply the bagging technique to combine multiple forests to reduce variance and improve the accuracy. Experiments show we can improve the prediction performance by about 10% in AUROC.

articleTitle: A practical quantum public-key encryption model
abstract: In this paper, a practical quantum public-key encryption model is proposed by studying the recent quantum public-key encryption. This proposed model makes explicit stipulations on the generation, distribution, authentication, and usage of the secret keys, thus forms a black-box operation. Meanwhile, this proposed model encapsulates the process of encryption and decryption for the users, and forms a blackbox client-side. In our models, each module is independent and can be replaced arbitrarily without affecting the proposed model. Therefore, this model has a good guiding significance for the design and development of the quantum public key encryption schemes.

articleTitle: MOOCs in China's universities: Practice, characteristics and trends
abstract: With the Massive open online courses (MOOCs) platform Coursera, Udacity and edX established in the United States, MOOCs led to a major change of education in global. MOOCs have experienced the development process of Network Course, National Excellent Network Courses, and Excellent Resource Sharing Course, HMOOCs by pushing with the government, colleges and universities in China. MOOCs are applied to course learning model innovation, intercollegiate elective credits and teachers' training. In the development process, that Chinese MOOCs show characteristics are MOOCs' localization, strengthen cooperation and alliances, promoting sharing and construction quality courses. At present, there are some important research problems, such as how to use MOOCs to solve China's educational equity issues, how to achieve the sustainable development and continuous innovation of China's MOOCs.

articleTitle: Mobile usability: An antecedent for influencing purchase intention moderated by omni-channel integration quality
abstract: The new concept of omni-channel has inspired researchers to develop a model of consumer confusion to increase purchase intention. Previous studies were tested that the omni-channel integration quality can improve customer satisfaction. As a novelty, this study introduced omni-channel integration as a moderating variable that influence consumer confusion to the intention of purchase. This paper constituted a hypothetical development about the proposed omni-channel integration as a part of the e-quality service. This proposed research aimed to explore the effect of consumer confusion towards purchase intention moderated by omni-channel integration. Three hypotheses were modeled in this research proposal. The future results of this research are expected to be a significant contribution towards business, science, and society.

articleTitle: E-commerce supply chain coordination under demand influenced by historical sales rate
abstract: Nowadays, E-Commerce has become the main choice of consumers. However, online consumers are more likely to be affected by other consumers. And In this condition supply chain decision-making are need to be discussed. We build a two-period supply chain model based on e-platform, and the willingness for purchase will influenced by former period's sales rate. Decision-making are discussed in both certainty demand and random demand scenarios. Firstly, on deterministic demand scenario, we studied on the short-term cooperation and the long-term cooperation between two supply chain members. And then, on random demand scenario, we also use revenue sharing contract to coordination the supply chain. We find that revenue sharing contract can coordinate the supply chain in deterministic models, but a transfer payment are needed; However, in stochastic demand model, we find that the degree of how the first period's sales rate effect the second period will takes effect on whether supply chain can get optimal value or not.

articleTitle: Developing an emergency response conceptual framework for network centric disaster operations
abstract: The purpose of this research is to develop an Emergency Response Conceptual Framework to categorize and classify emergency operations in the current environment with highly interactive networking connections. It is hoped that this paper will provide a common ground for integration and interchangeability among many diverse information systems involved in the Emergency Management field. The entire set of emergency management functions relies on command and control systems to conduct operations and activities. Applying military Command and Control theory, the conceptual framework examines the information management in disaster operations from two perspectives: vertically, regarding command and horizontally, regarding collaboration. The research shows that there is no viable framework with a built-in information-sharing system currently. This paper constructs a response network topology to include all these operational nodes for dealing with mass casualty incidents, which is critical to have information sharing consistent with the process flow.

articleTitle: Optimized partitioned binary interpolative coding
abstract: Inverted index is the core data structure in large scale information retrieval systems such as Web search engine. Index compression techniques are usually used to reduce the storage and transmission time from disk to memory. Many index compression schemes have been proposed and among them Binary Interpolative Coding (IPC) is one of the most widely used schemes due to its superior compression ratio(CR). However we find the bottleneck of CR of IPC is the existing of over-long d-gaps in the inverted lists. To avoid them and to strengthen the advantage of CR of IPC we propose two improvement schemes including an optimized one. We discuss our method in detail and also introduce some important implementation details. Experimental results on two publicly available standard corpora show that compared with normal IPC, our method reduces the amount of storage by 13% with a negligible time cost incensement of less than 1% in Boolean AND, WAND and Rank queries.

articleTitle: Quality of service: Introduction of a new framework and a novel measurement technique
abstract: Quality of Service (QoS) and Inter-domain traffic control are the current research topics in the fields of computer communication and IP Telephony in Local Area Network (LAN), Wide Area Network (WAN) and Wi-Fi network. By appropriate design and implementation of QoS and traffic control in a corporate network a significant amount of bandwidth and thereby money can be saved. Performance and reliability are also enhanced in this process. In the current QoS framework emphasis has only been put on layer 2 and layer 3, using traffic classification, scheduling and provisioning. Also, there is no effective means of measuring an agency's QoS implementation level. In this paper we have proposed a new QoS framework which includes QoS at all 7 layers of OSI reference model. We have also introduced a new technique, Quality of Service Quotient (QoSQ) for measuring an agency's QoS posture. We have implemented QoS in a NSW government agency following this new QoS framework and have provided ‘bandwidth’ usage data for both pre and post QoS implementation. The data shows considerable subscribed bandwidth savings (55%) and increased average bandwidth usage (30%).

articleTitle: Ontology-based argument acquisition for argumentative agent
abstract: In the open argumentative multi-agent systems, structured arguments and counter-arguments are acquired and exchanged by agents dynamically to build dialogs. Argument acquisition by deductive reasoning explores the value of knowledge for agents to build dialogs autonomously. Desired arguments shall contain all the deductive information and be able to express classical negation. However, previous argument acquisitions by deductive reasoning either require manual work or cannot generate the desired arguments dynamically and automatically. A method of argument acquisition based on domain ontology and Argument Ontology is proposed. First, a minimum set of axioms is obtained from the domain ontology expressed by OWL and SWRL. Then, it is translated to a Prolog knowledge base for building structured arguments. The Argument Ontology is used for storage and retrieval of the constructed arguments. Experiments show that structured arguments and counter-arguments are acquired and exchanged by agents to build dialogs autonomously in decision making.
